_comment: Walk-in quest triggers (web/quest-triggers.js): a quest scene that starts because the player stepped into a patch of ground. rect = [x, y, width, height] in world pixels; enter-only (the previous frame was outside, this one inside); once defaults to true; when gates on the quest layer's own status (available / active / ready / done). draft: true is local testing only (tools/build_quests.py --with-drafts), like a draft quest. Check with: node tools/check_triggers.mjs

scene.name: Cipher
scene.text: Hold. You have stepped onto the drop zone. Query: are you hurt? Status: no.

scene.name: Cipher
scene.text: The bridge is mine to watch until the order changes. Cross if you must. I will be here.
